latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — quickly color grade and export videos with cloud-powered Lightroom-style editing.

- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and MKV video files up to 500MB and 1080p output
- Automatic cloud setup with simple drag-and-drop or prompt-based workflow
- Apply Lightroom-style color grading, exposure, contrast, and saturation adjustments
- Fast turnaround: typical processing takes 1-2 minutes per clip
- Straightforward export, credits management, and session control built in
